meta.title: Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World

worlds.label: Failed iteration overlays
worlds.description: Transient; overwritten on Return by Death

events.label: Subaru summoned to Lugunica
events.description: An ordinary shut-in, Subaru Natsuki, is abruptly summoned to a fantasy world with no powers, no sword skills and no idea why he was brought.

events.label: Checkpoint set — alley / loot house approach
events.description: His first evening in the capital ends in an alley ambush - and each time he dies, time snaps back to this same starting point: his first checkpoint.

events.label: First death (thugs / Elsa arc)
events.description: Subaru dies for the first time - murdered in the streets - and finds death itself is his only gift.

events.label: Return by Death to CP1
events.description: He wakes back at the alley with all his memories intact: Return by Death, working exactly once he understands what it is.

events.label: Meet Emilia properly with foreknowledge
events.description: Armed now with foreknowledge, Subaru properly meets Emilia - the silver-haired half-elf whose stolen insignia set his first day's disasters in motion.

events.label: Survive Elsa with allies
events.description: Using everything his deaths taught him, Subaru and allies finally survive the assassin Elsa and the night at the loot house.

events.label: Checkpoint moves — mansion arc
events.description: Surviving moves his checkpoint forward: the next anchor point for his deaths is Roswaal's mansion, deep in its own secrets.

events.label: Mansion deaths (Rem/Ram/Beatrice routes)
events.description: At the mansion, Subaru dies again and again - poisoned, slaughtered, hunted - in loops where Rem and Ram and the library's keeper all turn against him.

events.label: Return by Death to mansion CP
events.description: Each mansion death returns him to the same morning there, and he must deduce which of the seemingly impossible deaths was real.

events.label: Cult curses / Rem truth
events.description: The truth in the loops: a witch's curse marks Subaru, and Rem's hatred of witches - and of the thing inside him - drives her killings.

events.label: Save Rem; confront cult threat
events.description: Subaru breaks the mansion's cycle, saves Rem from her despair and her fate, and wins an ally who will love him across every loop after.

events.label: Subaru vows to save everyone without wasting RbD
events.description: Scarred by the loops, Subaru vows to stop dying pointlessly - to carry each Return by Death as if it were the last.

events.label: Return by Death discovered
events.description: The discovery that his deaths rewind the world to a checkpoint - and that only he remembers any of it.

events.label: Failed loops / trauma accumulation
events.description: The failed loops pile up in his memory alone: every torture, every death of friends, carried by the one person no one else can see suffering.

events.label: Checkpoint advances after major arcs
events.description: After each major arc, the rewind point moves forward - the story's way of turning survival into progress.

events.label: Return by Death first trigger
events.description: The first Return by Death - dying in an alley and waking to live the evening again.

events.label: Checkpoint advances unpredictably
events.description: The checkpoints shift unpredictably - Subaru never knows which moment his next death will return him to.

events.label: Bond with Emilia
events.description: Across every loop, the constant is Emilia - the person he keeps returning to save, and the reason he keeps standing up.

events.label: Satella / witch of envy link to RBD
events.description: Return by Death is no free gift: it belongs to the Witch of Envy, who loves him, and whose hand he can feel taking his heart at every mention.

events.label: Cannot tell others about RBD
events.description: The rule with teeth: tell anyone about the returns and the Witch punishes it - time freezes, or a loved one's heart is squeezed before his eyes.

events.label: Multiple arc resets (mansion, cult, etc.)
events.description: The pattern of the story: each arc is a knot of deaths and deductions - mansion, cult, sanctuary - tightened and untied across repetitions.

events.label: Psychological cost and growth
events.description: What the loops cost and give: Subaru breaks, learns, and grows into someone who can stand in a world that kills him to teach him.

ruleEffects.effect: Death rewinds to checkpoint; Subaru retains memory

outcome.summary: Return by Death rewrites from moving checkpoints; Subaru retains memory and progresses arcs at great cost.
